chunks: Every eye will weep on the Day of Judgment except three eyes: an eye that wept out of the fear of Allah, an eye that was lowered from the things Allah has forbidden, and an eye that stayed awake in the way of Allah.

key_terms.خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ: reverent fear and awe of Allah that leads to sincere weeping
key_terms.غُضَّتْ: was lowered or restrained, especially from looking at what is forbidden
key_terms.فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: in the way of Allah, for His cause
key_terms.مَحَارِمِ اللَّهِ: the things Allah has forbidden and made inviolable
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Judgment, when all people are resurrected and held to account

ai.seo_question: Which eyes are exempt from weeping on the Day of Judgment according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that certain deeds carried out with sincerity and taqwa bring special safety on the Day of Judgment. It praises weeping from خشية of Allah, restraining the gaze from haram, and remaining vigilant in the سبيل of Allah.
